Package backend

Class ExecutionFrame

java.lang.Object
backend.ExecutionFrame
public class ExecutionFrame extends Object
Represents the execution state for a script or block while the interpreter is running it.

  • Constructor Details

    • ExecutionFrame

      public ExecutionFrame(ArrayList<Command> commands, String type)
      Creates a new ExecutionFrame with the given list of commands and type. The index is initialized to 0, remainingIterations is initialized to 0, and conditionExpression is initialized to null.
      Parameters:
      commands - the commands to execute in this frame
      type - the type of execution frame
